blocks.title: Intellectual property
blocks.text: Intellectual property (IP) un qanooni huqooq ka majmooa hai jo zehan ki takhleeqat, jaise ijadat, adabi aur fanni kaam, designs, alamaat, naam aur tijarat mein istemal tasaveer, ko bachate aur takhleeq karne walon ko apne kaam par ikhtiyar aur munafa dete hain.

blocks.prompt: IP huqooq ko takhleeqi salahiyat ka inaam kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh takhleeq karne walon ko ikhtiyar dete hain ke un ka kaam kaun istemal kare aur us se kamayein, to takhleeq ki mehnat tasleem aur ada hoti hai.

items: Intellectual property: zehan ki takhleeqat par qanooni huqooq.
